Marta (People Ops): Heads-up: starting parental leave Mon Sep 6 for 10 weeks. I'm moving to Spain the week before for family support. Two quick asks: 1) what's the exact deadline for docs so the Redwood top-up and US tax withholding are handled correctly? 2) can my direct deposit stay to the US account or do I need to set up a Spanish account before going?

People Ops Bot: Please submit via https://hr.redwood.com/leave and attach supporting docs (birth/adoption cert, FMLA if eligible). For international moves, attach passport page and new address. See cross-border payroll note: https://finance.redwood.com/cross-border.

Marta (People Ops): Thanks. Any lead time numbers for payroll?

Payroll (Finance): For parental top-up to be included in the first leave pay run, upload all docs at least 10 business days before leave start. If you change country residency, tax withholding rules may change; notify finance-relocation@redwood.com ASAP. Keeping US direct deposit is usually fine for short-term moves but we need to know if you'll become tax resident in Spain (that triggers different reporting).

Marta (People Ops): Understood — I'll upload docs today and ping finance-relocation. If I become Spanish resident, will Redwood withhold Spanish taxes or do I handle them locally?

Payroll (Finance): If residency changes, we coordinate with our payroll vendor: they may require a local tax number and modify withholding. In many cases employees pay local taxes and file US returns separately; depends on treaty. We'll loop in payroll vendor and legal if needed.

Jon (Engineering Manager): I can take your on-call rotation and interviews. Marta, can you drop one-page handoff + annotate runbook pages you care about? Prefer in repo: /docs/oncall/marta.

Alex (IT Support): If you need your laptop shipped to Spain, open a ticket to it-support@redwood.com now. Shipping + customs can take 10-15 business days depending on region. Option: leave laptop at HQ and request loaner shipped from partner office in EU.

Marta (People Ops): Good call. I also want to keep two async check-ins (30 min) during leave — is that allowed?

People Ops Bot: Limited check-ins are allowed with manager sign-off. Set "Limited availability" on the leave form and include preferred windows.

Marta (People Ops): Sharing a quick checklist here for visibility so others can comment:

```
- Submit leave request: https://hr.redwood.com/leave
- Upload: birth cert, passport, proof of address, FMLA if eligible
- Upload >= 10 business days before Sep 6 for payroll top-up
- Email finance-relocation@redwood.com if changing tax residency
- Choose laptop option: ship vs. loaner (it-support@redwood.com)
- Create 1-page handoff + update runbooks (/docs/oncall/marta)
- Set Limited availability on form and note check-in windows
```

Jon (Engineering Manager): I'll review the handoff and schedule shadowing blocks this week. Also confirm who owns the fortnightly infra run — tag them in the doc.

Payroll (Finance): Also flag: benefits enrollment windows can shift with international moves. We'll send a tailored checklist after the leave form is submitted.

Marta (People Ops): Thanks everyone — uploading now and will post the handoff link here once done :pray:
